# Assets · References

4 files under `assets/References/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for menu-panel.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# References

源站与游戏系统界面的原始截图，用于核对规则，不在页面中使用。

- `menu-panel.png`：官网菜单面板。页面只有一个重点（当前项为墨色实底，其余为低对比度描边）；四角各放一组小元素，入口组集中在右半部；入口的图标靠左、文字居中、间距一致；没有说明文字。
- `game-badge-tile.png`：游戏选择页。提醒角标的中心落在卡片外框的右上转角。
- `game-map-hud.webp`：游戏地图界面。功能入口为同尺寸方格，提醒角标落在方格右上转角。
- `page-loader.webp`：官网首屏加载。左侧竖向进度条，底部百分比读数。
- `section-title.png`：官网区块标题。英文标签条在上，中文标题在下。
- `color-line.png`：装饰色条，粉、绿、黄三段。
